label: MRtrix3 label2colour
description:
Convert a parcellated image (where values are node indices) into a colour image
Many software packages handle this colouring internally within their viewer program; this binary explicitly converts a parcellation image into a colour image that should be viewable in any software.

parameters.label: quiet
parameters.description: do not display information messages or progress status; alternatively, this can be achieved by setting the MRTRIX_QUIET environment variable to a non-empty string.

parameters.label: nthreads
parameters.description: use this number of threads in multi-threaded applications (set to 0 to disable multi-threading).
parameters.usage: 使用原始命令参数；未指定的可选参数不传给软件。
parameters.software_default: 参见本机安装版本原始帮助。

input_slots.label: lut
input_slots.description: Provide the relevant colour lookup table (if not provided, nodes will be coloured randomly)

output_slots.label: colour_out
output_slots.description: the output colour image The output meaning depends on the input and selected operation. This generic image port does not certify anatomical labels, diffusion orientation, tissue fractions or spatial alignment.
